2. Software Engineering — Clean, rigorous codebases built for high-performance enterprise environments.
3. SaaS Engineering — Multi-tenant platforms designed for aggressive scale and seamless vertical integration.
4. Cloud Architecture — Distributed global systems using serverless paradigms and elastic load balancing (AWS, GCP, Azure).
5. Mobile App Development — Native and cross-platform mobile experiences engineered for the modern user (iOS, Android, React Native).
6. Brand Identity Design — Visual identities that project power and establish dominance in crowded markets.
7. UI/UX Design — Component-driven design systems built for rapid market iteration and user authority.
8. Strategy & Consulting — Technology stack selection, information architecture, and milestone roadmapping.
